title: Q-ASHBY-rule-text: SECOND-LOOP-KERNEL-1 and ORG-THEORY-1 are not yet written into agents/AGENTS.md and its seed copy
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** PR 2641 merged
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q SECOND-LOOP-KERNEL-1 -- agents/AGENTS.md seed/agents/AGENTS.md
**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q SECOND-LOOP-KERNEL-1 -- agents/AGENTS.md seed/agents/AGENTS.md
**Prediction:** rules_with_agent_text >= 1 within 24 h
**Out of scope:** changing the module code; any edit to other rules
**Status:** closed

Problem: the worker-gate refuses model-branch edits to files over 61440 bytes, and both AGENTS.md copies are larger, so the standing rule text could not ship in PR 2641. The rule is registered in seed/doctrine/constitution.json (rule second-goal-in-code) and the register seed/autonomy/secondloop.json. Add one bullet in each AGENTS.md copy through the path that is allowed to edit large files, then run python3 scripts/system.py --write in seed/.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T10:57:40Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
